Metadata.description:
Who a resource is. Identity is `name`; grouping is by label, never by
where the document is stored.

annotations.description: Free notes; never used to select.

uid.description:
Identity that outlives the name: a UUID v4 assigned once, never derived
from the name (Kubernetes `metadata.uid`). Renaming a resource keeps it.

PackSpec.description:
The spec of the `Pack` kind: an ordered set of sections, each an ordered
list of decisions. A decision belongs to the pack its id names (its
`<pack>/` prefix) and to the section of this list that names it.

variables.description:
Named CEL values the `cel` checks and fixes of the pack's decisions share.
A decision uses one by naming it, as it uses one of its own `variables`:
the pack's variables a decision names (directly, or through another) are
put before its own, in this order, and see the same `options`, selected
value and `file`. A variable that names none of those is evaluated once
per file, however many subjects the file has. The name of a pack variable
is not one of the decision's.

SectionSpec.description: A section of a pack, listing its decisions by name inside the pack.

decisions.description: Names of the decisions, without the pack prefix, in reading order.

name.description: Kebab-case name of the section inside the pack.

Variable.description:
A named CEL value: an intermediate result the check, its message, its
evidence and its fix all see by name.

name.description: A lower-case identifier that no expression variable already uses.

params.description:
With parameters, the variable is a function of them: `name(a, b)` is
the expression, with its parameters bound to the arguments. It sees the
`options` and the `file` of the caller, and nothing else.
